shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git diff package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
cat lib/db.js app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore __agent_eval__/run.mjs; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts; echo ---; grep -n "cacheTag\|cacheLife" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/cache-tag.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '

[^<]*

\|]*>\|]*>[^<]*\|[^<]*' | head -20; echo; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "second request: %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n" http://localhost:3123/; pkill -f "next start" ; git status --short
